description: Fetch a single Dryad dataset by its DOI (e.g. "doi:10.5061/dryad.hx3ffbgjj" or "10.5061/dryad.hx3ffbgjj"). Returns full metadata — title, authors, abstract, keywords, publication date, field of science, license, version — plus a download URL for the dataset files. Keyless.

doi.description: Dataset DOI, with or without the "doi:" prefix (e.g. "doi:10.5061/dryad.hx3ffbgjj").

name: get_dataset
title: Get Dataset
